actual_scope: Prove, for saturated replayed words W(D)=S_N T_N ... S_1 T_1 (N=n+1 shears T_j=I-2x_j y_j, scalings S_e=I+(D_s-1)E_e with idempotent E_e, coordinate target masks, atomic LOCAL pieces, characteristic 0, replay W(+1)=D^w and W(-1)=-D^w), that some coordinate lies in every mask under (a) single-time scaling, (b) one split stage with no non-local piece between a shear and its LOCAL piece, or (c) any splits whose in-window pieces of distinct stages commute. The hub target 8L+1 (=145 on the 9|9 chain-nested root of #6833) therefore cannot be lowered in those families. State Lemma M (the master identity is equivalent to one invertible M(D) conjugating the primed shears to the original ones).
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a joint helper basis and a legal causal split on the complete invoice. This package is a structural obstruction for the root: it constructs no word, prices nothing, and says that splitting a stage's scaling over several times, in the three families above, cannot remove a coordinate from any mask.
bottleneck_link: docs/research/research-family-status.md; the statement fixes which root edits (per-stage scaling splits) are excluded and which remain open.
stop_rule: No kappa claim. The theorem is conditional on the listed hypotheses (saturation N=n+1, characteristic 0, coordinate masks, atomic LOCAL simultaneous with its shear, one D per stage, replay at Q=+1 and Q=-1, and H6a or H7 or single-time scaling). Non-commuting interleaved pieces, the mid slot with a non-commuting first piece, non-atomic LOCAL, unsaturated headers, non-coordinate masks and Q-dependent frame operations are not covered. No word is constructed and nothing is priced.
evidence: README.md (statement and self-contained proof), check.py (exact recomputation on chains (1|1) and (2|2) and on random non-commuting and commuting piece configurations, with an H6a-violating control).

open_questions.question: Does the hub survive when two or more stages are split and their in-window pieces interleave without commuting (H6a fails)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the only family with several split stages not covered. A hub-free solution would need masks of size at least 3 for each split stage; a proof would remove H6a.
open_questions.first_step: For n=4, N=5 with masks P={0,1,2}, Q={1,2,3}, R={0,3}, write each B_j=Lam_{<j}M as an unknown in the centraliser coset of T_j with Gamma_j=B_{j+1}B_j^-1 a product of piece factors, impose Q=+1 and Q=-1, and solve exactly; then repeat at n=6 with two split stages.
open_questions.blocked_by: The Q=+1 replay does not force commutation of the pieces (interleaved pieces with [F_1,E_1] nonzero satisfy it), so the Q=-1 condition would have to be used in closed form, and no closed form is known.

open_questions.question: Does the hub survive for one split stage whose second piece sits in the mid slot (between T_N and the LOCAL piece of the last stage) when the first piece does not commute with a coordinate stage placed before it?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the one placement of a single split stage that H7 excludes and that the commuting hypothesis H6a does not cover.
open_questions.first_step: Fix n=4, N=5 and the split stage P in the in-window set, place E_2 between T_N and the LOCAL piece of the last stage, and decide whether the top coefficient c can be nonzero with y_N E_1 supported on a row outside the common columns while Lemma M holds.
open_questions.blocked_by: Without the commutation of the last stage's mask with E_1 the support of y_N E_1 is not controlled. One configuration (n=4 triangle, shears (2,5,3), E_2 mid) is excluded by an exact reduction plus a Groebner basis equal to {1}, without a positive control; the general case has no proof.

open_questions.question: Is the hub forced when LOCAL is not atomic, so that x_p or y_p leaves the stage's mask?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Then g_{p+1,p} need not carry D_p, the exponent pattern fails, and this is the only route found that keeps the unsaturated cost.
open_questions.first_step: Write the native job with a twist mixing masked and unmasked coordinates and test whether every target remains a whole monomial job at both characters.
open_questions.blocked_by: No model of such a LOCAL with all targets whole monomials has been written.

open_questions.question: Is a hub-free realisation possible with an unsaturated header (M=N+2)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Z then has rank 2, the cocycle g_il = +-g_ij g_jl fails, and the hub argument gives nothing.
open_questions.first_step: State the rank-2 analogue of Lemma M and test it on the 1|1 chain with one added shear.
open_questions.blocked_by: The saturated Gram structure used here is lost, and the price of the extra header rank has not been compared with any hub-free ceiling.

open_questions.question: Does the conclusion extend to non-coordinate masks or to Q-dependent frame operations?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The theorem fixes all frame operations to be Q-independent and absorbs them; relaxing either could reopen a hub-free family.
open_questions.first_step: Replace the diagonal D^w target by a conjugate of it and check which steps use a common frame; list the Q=+i and Q=-i conditions for a Q-dependent frame.
open_questions.blocked_by: The reduction to Q=+1 and Q=-1 used here relies on Q-independence, and no statement of the extra characters in closed form is available.
